name: all-star-players-store-api
description: Square-backed store API for All Star Players. Runs as one AWS Lambda behind an HTTP API.

scripts.package: rm -rf build function.zip && mkdir -p build && cp -r index.mjs lib package.json package-lock.json build/ && cd build && npm ci --omit=dev --silent && zip -qr ../function.zip . && cd .. && rm -rf build && echo 'built function.zip'
